overview: David Ondrej demonstrates a high-volume coding-agent operation across model/harness choices, narrow tasks, independent review, cloud and local sessions, subagents and recurring loops.
whyItMatters: The most actionable material is the system around the model: bounded tasks, trustworthy reviews, recoverable sessions and selective automation. His session and commit counts are not quality evidence.
ghostMeshTakeaway: Pilot one read-only deduplicated loop derived from repeated owner interventions. Keep existing execution and publication custody and reject unlimited review permissions.
